name: Docker Agent
description: Lets developers define multi-agent teams in YAML and run them with the docker agent CLI, expose them over MCP or an HTTP API, and share them through OCI registries.

skills.name: Multi-Agent Teams
skills.description: Defines teams of specialized agents in YAML that delegate tasks to one another.

skills.name: MCP Mode
skills.description: Exposes configured agents as MCP tools with docker agent serve mcp for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and other clients.

skills.name: API Server
skills.description: Serves agents over an HTTP API with SSE-streamed runtime events and session management via docker agent serve api.

skills.name: Agent Distribution
skills.description: Pushes agent configs to any OCI registry and pulls and runs them elsewhere.

skills.name: RAG
skills.description: Adds pluggable retrieval with BM25, embeddings, hybrid search, and reranking to agents.
